title: chaerophyllum cicutaria subsp. villarsii
intro: Chaerophyllum cicutaria subsp. villarsii, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae) native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaerophyllum cicutaria subsp. villarsii include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-ulcerogenic effects, which may help alleviate anxiety, muscle spasms, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
